olivia: Quick ask - Nebula Health wants an exception: reverse-charge VAT handling for EU invoices + net45. They're a non-EU buyer but expect to self-account VAT. Finance needs confirmation we can issue net45 and mark invoice as reverse-charge. Also they asked to delay payment of onboarding fee until month 2.

sam: VAT ops: reverse-charge ok if we have VAT ID and confirm B2B status. need customer's VAT number and contact for tax docs. net45 is fine for established customers, for new ones recommend deposit.

tereza: commercial: they're an existing customer expanding to a private deployment, billing contact stays same. onboarding fee waiver would be a stretch, but deferral to month 2 could work with deposit.

miguel: legal: ensure contract references tax handling clause and collects VAT ID. if they are non-EU buyer, reverse-charge may not apply; confirm location and entity registration. also need to confirm which entity we're contracting with (Redwood US vs Redwood EU).

invoice-bot: invoice-33456 (onboarding) status: pending.

olivia: i'll collect VAT ID and entity docs tonight. proposal: net45, onboarding fee deferred to invoice month 2, require refundable deposit equal to onboarding fee until onboarding invoice paid.

sam: ok - confirm VAT ID and we'll mark invoice accordingly.

olivia: noted. will update when VAT ID is in.
